configuration.surrogates: h(0),h(1) independently uniform in{1/4,1/2,3/4}; naturally probability-valued
configuration.law: M=uniform{0,1}, fixed true known finite joint
configuration.unit: independent simulated draw of surrogate endpoint pair, E deterministic from unit covariates
configuration.quality_model: existing fixed-bin histogram regression on endpoint pair, fit MC labels on B; unseen fallback global training mean
configuration.exact_population_diagnostic: post-calibration enumerate9endpoint pairs and binomial8score draws, no scorer access/tuning
configuration.global_decision: no efficacy/novelty/adequacy claim; no practical effect margin frozen
configuration.resources: stdlib pilot timeout120s, no new packages for H2; memory/time measured or NOT_MEASURED
configuration.cost_matching: sameE/shared independent loss eval; actual per-role queries counted; full matched total cost NOT_ESTABLISHED
configuration.independence: conceptual IID product law; disjoint role/unit PRNG streams implement reproducible simulation, not proof of real-world IID
configuration.fitting_separation: fixed analytic f/E rule beforeB; B fit only; C calibration; T eval only; score draws disjoint from loss draws; common final loss data allowed across policies only
configuration.retuning: forbidden after results; bug corrections retain attempt log and do not alter scientific thresholds
configuration.revision_reason: BEFORE any H2 pilot outcomes: include existing accepted-count test to audit transformed-controller power; no scientific threshold/sample change
configuration.positive_control: separate deterministic perfect-surrogate bank verifies existing LTT power, not efficacy evidence
